existing_questions_not_linked.stem: Matangini Hazra, known as "Gandhi Buri", was killed during the Quit India Movement at which place?
existing_questions_not_linked.note: Banglapedia confirms the title and that she was shot leading a procession in Midnapore, but does not name the exact place of death; not linked. Same for the indian_history.js variant ending 'at:'.

existing_questions_not_linked.stem: Who gave Gandhi the title "Mahatma" and was himself called "Gurudev" by Gandhi?
existing_questions_not_linked.note: Fetched sources use 'Gurudev' for Tagore but say nothing about the Mahatma title or who gave it; not linked, answer neither confirmed nor contradicted.
